title: fq-attestation/1 — signed provenance line
description: One line of attestations/layer-LLL.kK.jsonl. The file is JSON Lines: each line is a detached-signature ENVELOPE whose payload is the base64 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces) that was signed. Multiple lines per file are expected — one per fragment covered, and eventually countersignatures by third parties — so consumers must iterate lines, not json.loads the whole file. Verifying the signature requires a public key obtained OUT OF BAND (keys/FINGERPRINTS in the git repo); the keyid field says which key signed, it does not confer authority. Derived from files emitted by fq_repack and fq_prime (real examples: ~/fq-segments/GLM-5.2-EXL3-FQ/attestations, ~/fq-primed/segments-342/{shared-h,expanded}/attestations).

payload.description: base64 of the exact bytes that were signed

signature.description: base64 ed25519 signature, 64 bytes decoded — anything shorter is a failed verification, not a placeholder

keyid.description: hex ed25519 public key that made the signature; authority comes from keys/FINGERPRINTS, not from this field

predicate.description: repack-of: the fragment's bytes were copied verbatim from `materials`. derived-from: computed from `parents` by the exact rule in `derivation`. encode-of: produced by running the pinned encoder on the pinned inputs — reproducible only within the determinism scope declared in `determinism_scope`; across stacks the honest claim is equivalence-of, not identity. equivalence-of: measured numeric equivalence, not byte identity.

expert_sha256.description: expert id -> sha256 of that expert's contiguous byte span in the fragment. This is what makes a single-expert ranged read verifiable.

materials.description: repack-of: what the bytes were copied out of. encode-of: the pinned base model/revision and encoder capture evidence; it deliberately does not use repack-of's repo/revision/file aliases.

parents.description: derived-from: the fragments this one was computed from, pinned by digest

derivation.description: derived-from: the exact rule, named and described

dependencies.description: other files needed to interpret this fragment (e.g. a shared_h profile)

determinism_scope.description: encode-of: the boundary within which re-running the encoder is expected to reproduce these bytes. Outside it, the honest claim is measured equivalence, not identity.

supersedes.description: digest, file name, or note identifying an earlier attestation this line replaces
